caption: Mount Pilatus, Lucerne
composition: Lucerne lakeshore looking southwest to the Pilatus massif · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Lucerne lakeshore, Mount Pilatus rises as a steep, jagged limestone massif southwest of the city, with several rocky summits rather than one snow pyramid. The lake fills the foreground under gray light. This frame keeps to the open shore and does not use the Chapel Bridge or the Water Tower. The Open-Meteo model is overcast, with no rain.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Mount Pilatus from the Lucerne lakeshore

approval_basis: Gate1: Mount Pilatus as a jagged limestone massif with multiple snow-dusted rocky summits — not a single snow pyramid — rising over Lake Lucerne with the lakeshore and houses in the foreground; Chapel Bridge and Water Tower correctly absent. Gate2: both formats at exact 1920×1080 / 864×1080; on-image 'Mount Pilatus, Lucerne', scenario 15:08, disclosure and 'Jason D's Vision' signature bottom-right all present and legible; weather retrieved 13:08:46Z for scenario 15:08, overcast 100% cloud consistent with the gray sky shown. Gate3: text-prompt-only, no photographic inputs. Gate4: no identifiable people, no focal logos (documented only). Gate5: no blockers.
